name: io.github.click6067-ship-it/fitllm
title: FitLLM
description: Read-only LLM hardware-fit calculator: checks whether a local LLM (GLM, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma, Llama...) fits on a given GPU, multi-GPU rig or Apple Silicon Mac — exact VRAM/unified-memory math incl. KV cache, quantization and architecture (MLA/sliding-window/MoE).
